headline: Nigeria Fuel Firm Conoil Posts $3.9M Nine-Month Profit on $208M Sales
summary: Nigerian fuel seller Conoil reported a nine-month profit of about $3.9 million on $208 million in sales, though third-quarter profit fell sharply.
why: Earnings reports from regional energy companies provide insight into domestic fuel demand, pricing pressures, and sector profitability in emerging African markets.

impacts.name: Conoil
impacts.why: The company reported a sharp fall in third-quarter profit despite nine-month earnings.
